cases.customer_question: Are existing HOGP and ScPP test reports sufficient for qualification at a given timing, and how do upcoming TCRL changes affect this?
cases.actual_issue: Determining sufficiency of test evidence depending on registration timing relative to TCRL active date changes.
cases.consultant_answer: Current test reports are sufficient if the product is registered before the new TCRL becomes active. After the active date, additional test cases introduced by the new TCRL must be included.
cases.final_recommendation: Align registration timing with TCRL active dates: complete registration before new TCRL activation to avoid additional testing, or plan to execute added test cases if registering later.
